mapper.insert: MERGE INTO RECON_BATCH_FILE T USING (SELECT #{batchId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} BATCH_ID, #{fileType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} FILE_TYPE FROM DUAL) S ON (T.BATCH_ID = S.BATCH_ID AND T.FILE_TYPE = S.FILE_TYPE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET FILE_NAME = #{fileName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FILE_PATH = #{path,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BYTE_COUNT = #{byteCount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, RECORD_COUNT = #{recordCount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, AMOUNT_TOTAL = #{amountTotal,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SHA256 = #{sha256,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, STATUS = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (BATCH_ID, FILE_TYPE, FILE_NAME, FILE_PATH, BYTE_COUNT, RECORD_COUNT, AMOUNT_TOTAL, SHA256, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{batchId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{path,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{byteCount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{recordCount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{amountTotal,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{sha256,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT BATCH_ID, FILE_TYPE, FILE_NAME, FILE_PATH, BYTE_COUNT, RECORD_COUNT, AMOUNT_TOTAL, SHA256, STATUS, REMOTE_PATH FROM RECON_BATCH_FILE WHERE BATCH_ID = #{batchId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY FILE_TYPE
